title: Mashed Sweet Potatoes
nutrition_tip: This mashed sweet potatoes recipe makes smooth mashed sweet potatoes enriched wi…

ingredients.name: 6 medium sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
0.75 cup warm 2% milk, or as needed
0.75 cup maple syrup, or to taste
0.5 cup softened butter, cut into chunks

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes, reduce the heat to medium-low, and simmer until tender, 20 to 30 minutes. Drain and transfer to a large bowl.
Mash potatoes with a potato masher until mostly smooth.
Gradually stir in milk until potatoes reach desired consistency.
Stir in syrup and butter until smooth.
